Patchwork CI now runs on 1,200 repositories.

When we launched, we promised it would always be free for open source. Plenty of people said we were crazy and asked how we planned to make money.

Today about 900 of those 1,200 repositories are open source.

Open source brought us users, and it also brought us data, feedback, and a community. Our most-requested feature, GitLab support, came straight from OSS maintainers. We shipped it on November 12.
